title: Towards Feasible Counterfactual Explanations: A Taxonomy Guided Template-based NLG Method
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct any benchmarks or measurements related to faith or religion. Its focus is on evaluating a method for generating feasible counterfactual explanations (cf-XAI) based on criteria like articulation, acceptability, feasibility, and sensitivity in non-religious domains.
findings: This paper does not analyze or contain any findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on generating feasible counterfactual explanations in AI, with user studies conducted in finance, health, and education domains. The paper discusses ethical concerns and sensitive features like race and sex, but does not extend this to religion.
